name: Process: Run translation: name translators and approvers per language, publish under one version, and translate the founding pages pre-opening
markdown_description:
P19 and I2. Before the first cohort's why block, every founding page (the destinations page, the architecture page, the cadence page, the charter page, the seat sheets, the module set) exists in every language on the pre-opening list, translated by the founders and the first leads who hold those languages, approved by the page's owner and a second holder, with the translation record listing each. In service, a team member who holds the language translates for pay on the authorship model, and a page publishes only when the record shows every version. The founders' and first leads' languages are named as a critical-path fact on the hiring calendar (S6 3.9). Extends `86akhb2kw` by reference. High.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
